provenance.paper_title: MUSE: Agentic 3D Scene Authoring via Memory-Grounded Incremental Requirement Satisfaction

evidence.paraphrase: Structured requirements, scene state, and reusable skills track incremental construction and editing.

The Inspector verifies each local scene operation and updates working, scene, and skill memory. For MUSE, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of working, scene, and skill memory.

Failed requirements trigger localized correction while preserving non-target scene content. For MUSE, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of working, scene, and skill memory.
Verified local operations are retained as reusable skill memory. For MUSE, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of working, scene, and skill memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 4): During inference, the operative memory component (working, scene, and skill memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state, abstraction of episodes into reusable experience; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
